summary: Math.atanh is implemented in its own file, one spec step per comment. Step 1 uses ops::to_number with `?`. Step 2 returns NaN, +0 and -0 unchanged; `n == 0.0` also matches -0.0, so the sign is kept. Step 3 uses plain comparisons, which are false for NaN, and returns NaN. Steps 4 and 5 return ±Infinity. Step 6 calls f64::atanh. No special-casing, no swallowed errors, no edits outside the in-scope file. The gate reports +2 test262 passes and no regressions.
